description_en: Associates multiple products with a project in a batch
description_zh: 批量关联产品到项目中
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-bind-products-into-project --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --project-id a12300000000 --product-keys example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchBindProductsIntoProject

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.
Enterprise Enterprise instance: This parameter is required. You can view the ID of your Enterprise Enterprise instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.
Public instance: This parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
公共实例：无需传入此参数
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The project ID.
Log on to the IoT Studio console (https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). In the upper-left corner, select the instance. In the left-side navigation pane, click Project Management.
In the common project list, find the target project, click the project card, and then view the project ID in the address bar
parameters.help_zh:
项目ID。
您可登录物联网应用开发控制台 (https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The list of ProductKey values of the products to be associated with the project
parameters.help_zh: 需要关联到项目的产品ProductKey列表
parameters.name: product_keys
